answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before bidding for work; release it only after random audits confirm the delivered result meets the task’s rules. A false result or duplicated submission forfeits the bond, while a clean record earns better access to paid tasks. An attacker can invent identities as easily as a fable, but each one needs capital: splitting into Sybils multiplies the bonds, whether the agents work on a canyon map or an island plan.
